description: This file defines the abstract class InputDStream, which serves as the base class for all input stream types in Spark Streaming. It includes methods for starting and stopping data reception, managing stream identity, scope, and timing validation.

classes.name: InputDStream
classes.description: An abstract base class for all input streams in Spark Streaming, providing core functionalities such as starting, stopping, and managing input stream properties.

methods.name: isTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the given time is valid based on the last valid time and the superclass validation.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no dependencies.

methods.name: slideDuration
methods.description: Returns the batch duration of the streaming context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Abstract method to initiate data reception, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Abstract method to stop data reception, to be implemented by subclasses.
